reviews.t: These are awesome!

They came in much quicker then I expected (5days) and the quality is pretty good for the price as well. They are thick so they hold back my hair while exercising without sliding off. Some are a little snugger then others but at about $1 a piece you can't beat it!

reviews.t: Great for working out
reviews.x: I got these headbands for keeping my hair back while I run. I like the thicker ones, because my hair is too short to put in a ponytail, so these keep my hair out of my face while I run. They are fairly tight and stretchy so they stay in place as much as something made of cotton can. Absorbent too! I was a little skeptical at first about picking my colors, but the seller was very prompt and friendly, and they arrived very quickly as well. Great quality for how cheap these are!

reviews.t: No apps, no wires, no batteries just perfect fit headbands, in beautiful colors and patterns
reviews.x: Awesome headbands. Perfect stretch-fit, wonderful bright colors. They were exactly what I wanted!

reviews.t: Absolutely recommend them!

They had mistakenly sent me a couple colors that were not my choices, and quickly sent me the ones I didn't get.  Bottom line is, I highly recommend them and you really can't go wrong with these. claims.text: Many reviewers praise the quality and value for the low price, calling them soft and well-made.
Reviewers frequently highlight the wide choice of colors and patterns, and the option to pick colors via email.
Several reviewers say the headbands stay in place and hold hair back well during exercise, though some find them tight.
A notable number of reviewers report the headbands slip off or ripped after one use.
Multiple reviewers mention fast shipping and good seller communication.
